chart.calendar_policy: each symbol uses its source calendar; verify alignment in the selected window

required: 30m KLine formal slices for rb/hc/i in the selected window
large ScaleTurnCalendar formal slices for rb/hc/i in the selected window
mid ScaleTurnCalendar formal slices for rb/hc/i in the selected window
delivery manifest and feature-slice index/statistics sufficient to locate those slices

allowed: ordinary import/API signature compatibility fixes required by the current authorized checkout
expressing the already-fixed rb/hc/i selector in the exact syntax accepted by the current API if blk@steel does not resolve exactly
using the current authorized plotting helper needed to realize the already-fixed one-figure relative-ratio view
path and serialization fixes that do not change data or feature semantics
forbidden: changing symbols, window, frequency, large/mid feature choice, SOF or stk_tlist
adding small scale, selecting a new use case or defining business key T
reconstructing first-visible/revision history or direction mappings
modifying shared aidata/mquant/tis/FRP source, switching checkout or upgrading dependencies
claiming delivery from URL existence, process exit code, or paths without opening the page and reading the formal data

non_goals: full environment or repository diff audit
